risk_factors.heading: We face risks related to security vulnerabilities in our products.
risk_factors.quote: We and third parties regularly identify security vulnerabilities with respect to our products and services. The same holds for the operating systems and workloads that run on them and the components that interact with them.

risk_factors.heading: Our business has suffered, and could in the future suffer, from manufacturing problems.
risk_factors.quote: Difficulties in the production process can reduce yields or interrupt production, and, as a result of such problems, we may on occasion not be able to deliver products or do so in a timely or cost-effective or competitive manner.

risk_factors.heading: Reliance on limited suppliers for equipment and materials
risk_factors.quote: Because the equipment that we purchase is complex, it is frequently difficult or impossible for us to substitute one piece of equipment for another or replace one type of material with another.

risk_factors.heading: Failure of our third party suppliers to perform could adversely affect our results of operations.
risk_factors.quote: If our outside suppliers are unable to satisfy our demand, or experience manufacturing difficulties, delays or reduced yields, our results of operations and ability to satisfy customer demand could suffer.

risk_factors.heading: Disruptions in our relationships with any one of our key customers could adversely affect our business.
risk_factors.quote: A substantial portion of our revenue is derived from our top customers, including our distributors. We cannot guarantee that we will be able to generate similar levels of revenue from our largest customers in the future.

risk_factors.heading: Reduction in government subsidies and grants or repayment demands
risk_factors.quote: These programs are subject to periodic review by the relevant governments, and if any of these programs are curtailed or discontinued, this could have a material adverse effect on our business, financial condition and results of operations.

risk_factors.heading: Natural disasters and climate change may negatively impact our business
risk_factors.quote: Environmental and other disasters, such as flooding, heavy precipitation large earthquakes, volcanic eruptions or nuclear or other disasters, or a combination thereof may negatively impact our business.
